import HartshorneLib.Chapter4IntrinsicResidue
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Finprod

/-!
# Finite-sum form of the intrinsic residue

The intrinsic residue has finite support, but later global arguments need to
replace its `finsum` by a concrete finite sum.  This module exposes that
conversion using the support of the differential order.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- The global intrinsic-residue `finsum` is the finite sum over its finite
support. -/
theorem finsum_curveRationalDifferentialResidue_eq_sum
    [QuasiCompact X.hom] (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :
    (∑ᶠ p : {x : X.left // x ≠ genericPoint X.left},
      curveRationalDifferentialResidue X p.2 ω) =
      ∑ p ∈ (curveRationalDifferentialResidue_support_finite X ω).toFinset,
        curveRationalDifferentialResidue X p.2 ω := by
  classical
  let s := curveRationalDifferentialResidue_support_finite X ω
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _
    (s := s.toFinset)]
  intro p hp
  exact (s.mem_toFinset).mpr hp

end
end Hartshorne
